items.rationale: The loop checks wording, not tool calls, so it exits on 'Done' while the edit_file call is still pending and never runs it. Believing the model's words signal completion is M1.
Each of the 6 tool-call turns counts, plus one for the final text-only reply: 7. With 6, the run ends as error_max_turns with no final response.
Only the success variant carries the result field, so check the subtype before reading it.
max_tokens means the reply hit the token limit, so it is truncated, not finished. Treating any non-tool_use stop as completion is M2.
